Age ≤50 yrs, no smallpox or mpox vaccination
Among 50 participants who reported only smallpox vaccination, antiorthopoxvirus IgG was detected in 19 (38%) and IgM in one (3%).
Among 80 participants aged <50 years who did not report smallpox or mpox vaccination, two (2.5%) had detectable antiorthopoxvirus immunoglobulin (Ig) G antibody.
Descriptive analyses were performed, and outcomes were reported by vaccination history and serologic results.
a CDC field team conducted an orthopoxvirus seroprevalence survey among persons accessing homeless services

methods_quotes.q: Descriptive analyses were performed, and outcomes were reported by vaccination history and serologic results.
Possible undetected infections identified by IgG testing were restricted to persons aged <50 years to avoid inclusion of participants who received smallpox vaccine during childhood.
Participants who reported unknown vaccination history or previous mpox infection were not included as having possible undetected mpox infections.
